Package hadur117.mini.core

Class Gun

java.lang.Object
hadur117.mini.core.Gun
public final class Gun extends Object
Deise's gun: Saor's per-opponent Markov play-it-forward with its graded vote (DEISE-6 to DEISE-9). A state packs one tick of an opponent's movement: acceleration sign, speed, and turn as a fraction of its turn rate. Each opponent has a row of up to ROW successors per state; an aim plays the target forward from its state by sampling successors until the bullet reaches it, and votes for the angle it ends at. Pure: the robot passes its Random.

    • aim

      public static double aim(char[][] table, int state, double x, double y, double heading, double velocity, double myX, double myY, double power, int playouts, Random random)
      The absolute bearing to fire at (DEISE-7, DEISE-8, DEISE-9). Each playout starts at the target with its state, heading and speed. A row with a sample moves the state to a random successor; an empty row holds it, which plays the target on as a circle. A playout through a row of fewer than WARM samples votes at most 5 + 12 a sample of that row; one that leaves the field votes 1. A vote spreads over the bins the target's width covers at its distance.

    • power

      public static double power(double energy, double targetEnergy, double distance, int others)
      Bullet power (DEISE-10): Saor's range power, log10(energy) * 325 / distance, capped at 1.9 plus one for every three opponents left, at what kills the target, and within Robocode's 0.1 to 3, so the speed the aim plays out is the speed the bullet flies.
